name: A source
title: Add a *SQL source*
lede: Posts kept in memory are lost at every restart. Importing *@fougere/adapter-sql* and one line in sources store them in SQLite. The app then refuses to start until the table exists, and *fougere migrate* creates it.
fig: PostHandler does not change. Only fougere.config.ts says where posts are stored: the import makes *sqlite* a source type, without it the line does not typecheck.
